audited_suspected_testing_frame: 10677 reported cases; the frame actually offered culture is never defined
specimen_scope: blood OR stool, pooled and unseparable
case_definition_summary: Nonstandardized; the paper states the clinical case definition relies on physician judgment
testing_selection_mechanism: Not reported. Culture was done at two Dushanbe hospitals while surveillance covered 12 clinics city-wide, so the cultured subset is a non-random hospital slice of unknown size
denominator_compatibility: No tested denominator. The 3294 (31%) confirmations are a fraction of REPORTED CASES, not positivity among tested patients
simple_model_status: not eligible: no tested denominator and specimens pooled across blood and stool
audit_notes: Largest outbreak in Appiah 2020 (10,677 cases). Bacteriologic confirmation required S. Typhi from 'a blood or stool sample' and the two specimen types are never separated. Median 6 days onset-to-hospitalisation implies substantial pre-culture antibiotic exposure. Government edict mandated 25-day hospitalisation, so admission does not select on severity here.

specimen_scope: STOOL culture only; no blood culture performed. Widal serology on all 317
case_definition_summary: Any patient presenting with clinical signs and symptoms consistent with typhoid fever, including headache, fever, stomach pains, diarrhea, or chronic constipation
testing_selection_mechanism: Self-selection by specimen submission: 188 of 317 'submitted a stool specimen suitable for culture'. No severity, serology or consent criterion stated; the paper does not explain the other 129
temporal_alignment: No epidemic curve; no figure or table of cases over time
denominator_compatibility: Zero blood cultures, so no blood denominator exists at any level
simple_model_status: not eligible: no blood culture performed
audit_notes: STOOL ONLY. 71/188 'showed growth' - the paper never states the organism was S. Typhi. Authors distrust their own results: 'the overall culture results are suspect because of rampant self-medication with antibiotics'. Would be miscoded if placed in any blood-culture stratum.

audited_suspected_testing_frame: 250 interviewed of >300 symptomatic; 100 purposively selected for stool
specimen_scope: STOOL culture only; blood culture explicitly declined
case_definition_summary: Temperature >38 C since outbreak onset, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, vomiting and weakness
testing_selection_mechanism: Explicit purposive quota: '100 patients for stool sample collection who belonged to different age groups and families'. Blood declined because 'majority of patients were not ready to participate in blood sample collection' and because of prior antibiotics
temporal_alignment: Daily curve of symptom percentages (Fig 1, n=300); percentages not counts
denominator_compatibility: Zero blood cultures; the 22/100 is stool positivity in an age/family quota sample, not a random subset of suspected cases
simple_model_status: not eligible: no blood culture performed
audit_notes: STOOL ONLY (22/100). Carries the single most explicit statement of the culture-selection mechanism in the whole review: blood culture was abandoned for CONSENT and PRIOR ANTIBIOTICS, not severity. Quotable evidence for the verification-bias section even though the study itself is unusable.

audited_suspected_testing_frame: 253 reported cases (55 laboratory-confirmed, 198 clinically diagnosed); culture frame not stated
specimen_scope: blood OR stool, pooled and unseparable
case_definition_summary: Persistent fever >=38 C for >3 days with headache, hypoeosinophilia OR a positive Widal test, without other diagnosed cause
testing_selection_mechanism: Effectively not reported: 'blood and stool samples were collected for the suspected cases' with no counts and no selection rule
temporal_alignment: No epidemic curve in this paper; narrative timing only
denominator_compatibility: No tested denominator; 55 isolates are blood-or-stool with no breakdown
simple_model_status: not eligible: no tested denominator and specimens pooled
audit_notes: This is a MOLECULAR paper, not the primary outbreak report. Epi denominators and any epidemic curve are in the Chinese-language reference (Dang J et al., Occup and Health 2011;27:1288-1289), which would need retrieval and translation. The case definition itself admits Widal-positive patients as 'clinically diagnosed'. Vi vaccine was used as a control measure with no coverage reported.

location: Xing-An County Middle School, Guangxi, China
audited_suspected_testing_frame: 24 met a composite case definition; the number offered blood culture is never stated
specimen_scope: BLOOD culture only (clean scope) plus Widal serology
case_definition_summary: S. Typhi by blood culture OR (temp >=38.5 C with fever >=24h) AND >=1 of fatigue/headache/malaise/anorexia/abdominal pain/constipation AND a positive Widal titre
testing_selection_mechanism: Explicit capacity gate: 'patients routinely had blood specimens taken at the time of admission for diagnosis of typhoid fever by use of the Widal test, and BLOOD CULTURES WERE DONE WHENEVER POSSIBLE'. Widal was routine; culture was opportunistic
denominator_compatibility: Blood-specific numerator (2) exists but has no denominator - the count offered culture is never given
audit_notes: One of Appiah's eight blood-culture-alone papers, but unusable: only 2/24 cases are culture-confirmed and 22/24 rest on Widal. 'Blood cultures were done whenever possible' is the second explicit statement that the culture gate is CAPACITY, not severity. School Vi campaign: 1701/2111 (81%) vaccinated; VE 71% (95% CI 34-87).

audited_suspected_testing_frame: 50 met the clinical case definition; 19 had ANY specimen tested, 31 had none
specimen_scope: blood, stool and urine pooled in the confirmed definition; blood-specific positives reported separately (9 of 19)
case_definition_summary: Fever for >=3 days since 1 Oct 1998 plus >=1 of chills, sweats, headache, anorexia, malaise, weakness, diarrhoea, constipation, abdominal pain, cough, vomiting, in a resident of Nauru
testing_selection_mechanism: Not reported as a clinical rule. Case-finding was retrospective and lab-record-driven: entry was via a positive culture OR a Widal screening record OR Typhoid-Committee recall, so the tested group is by construction the group that reached laboratory attention
temporal_alignment: Monthly epidemic curve available (Fig 1, 7 bars, confirmed vs clinical)
denominator_compatibility: The 19 is ANY-specimen tested, not blood; a blood-tested denominator is absent. Only 9 of 50 clinical cases would have been blood-confirmed
simple_model_status: not eligible: tested denominator is any-specimen, not blood
audit_notes: ALL 19 TESTED WERE POSITIVE (100% positivity, no test-negatives reported). That is diagnostic of non-systematic ascertainment: a systematically cultured suspect series would produce negatives. This is the clearest empirical illustration of the proposed exclusion rule (positivity >= Se_BC is unattainable for any admissible pi). No vaccination occurred; Vi appears only in a hypothetical cost model.

location: Sungai Congkak Recreational Park, Selangor, Malaysia
audited_suspected_testing_frame: No syndromic denominator exists; 45 clinic-record suspects sit outside the case definition
specimen_scope: blood OR urine OR stool pooled in the case definition; active screening used stool only
case_definition_summary: A person with or without clinical features, WITH ISOLATION of S. typhi in blood or urine or stool, who had visited the park on 27 Jan 2009
testing_selection_mechanism: Passive, clinician-initiated and confirmation-gated. The case definition requires isolation, so untested suspects can never become cases. The 4 index cases were blood-cultured as paediatric inpatients, i.e. admission was the de facto blood-culture gate; the retrospective arm cultured stool only, weeks after onset
denominator_compatibility: pi = 1 by construction: cases are defined by culture positivity, so no independent denominator exists
simple_model_status: not eligible: confirmed-case series with no syndromic denominator
audit_notes: Cleanest example of the confirmed-case-series pattern. The 12 cases are pooled blood/urine/stool and never disaggregated; only the 4 index paediatric cases are known blood-culture. Paper has numerous internal inconsistencies (68 vs 75 controls; 14 vs 39 suspects; OR 13 vs 14 vs 14.44). Typhoid vaccination of food handlers recommended post-outbreak with no numbers.

audited_suspected_testing_frame: None - isolates were collected consecutively from the laboratory
specimen_scope: BLOOD culture only (20 mL, BD Phoenix)
case_definition_summary: None. Cases are defined by isolate recovery: 24 S. Typhi isolates collected consecutively from blood cultures
testing_selection_mechanism: Not reported. Clinician-ordered culture at a private tertiary hospital; the paper never states who was cultured or how many
temporal_alignment: No figure, but per-isolate dates of isolation are tabulated, so a confirmed-case series is reconstructable
denominator_compatibility: No denominator of any kind: this is a lab isolate series, not a case series
simple_model_status: not eligible: confirmed-case series with no denominator
audit_notes: Molecular typing (ERIC-PCR) paper, not an epidemiological investigation: no case definition, no line list, no case-finding. Table has internal date errors contradicting the stated Dec 2015-Mar 2016 window (entries dated 2015 and Oct 2016).

location: Rural village, Poppra District, Tak Province, Thailand (Thai-Myanmar border)
audited_suspected_testing_frame: 11 suspected cases identified by active village surveillance, defined independently of culture result
specimen_scope: BLOOD (hemoculture) only for cases; stool used solely to screen contacts
case_definition_summary: Fever for >=3 days plus >=3 of abdominal pain, diarrhoea/constipation, nausea/vomiting, malaise/headache, rose spots, splenomegaly, with no other pathogen identified such as malaria
testing_selection_mechanism: Near-complete testing of the syndromic frame: hemoculture performed in 10 of 11 suspected cases. Active village surveillance, not severity- or admission-gated. The basis for the single untested case is not reported
temporal_alignment: No epidemic curve; onset range only (31 Oct - 11 Nov 1999)
denominator_compatibility: COMPATIBLE: an explicit syndromic denominator defined independently of culture, with a blood-only numerator and denominator
simple_model_status: not eligible under the current n>=20 rule (n=10), but methodologically the cleanest new candidate found
verification_model_status: candidate: the only new study whose tested group plausibly represents its suspected frame
audit_notes: THE CLEANEST NEW CANDIDATE. Blood-only PPV 5/10 = 50.0%, stated verbatim by the authors, with a 90.9% tested fraction and an active-surveillance denominator - the only one of eleven that approaches the target estimand. Fails only on size. Village population 749; 1 death (CFR 9.1%). Note positivity 0.50 approaches Se_BC (~0.62), implying pi near 0.8, consistent with an exposure-linked point-source frame rather than community surveillance.

audited_suspected_testing_frame: 26 patients ADMITTED TO HOSPITAL with symptoms suggesting typhoid; 250 symptomatic community members never cultured
specimen_scope: blood AND stool AND Widal; the 12/26 blood-only split is separately reported
case_definition_summary: No suspected definition; the frame is 26 hospital admissions with symptoms suggesting typhoid after staying in Utelle 14-18 Aug 1997
testing_selection_mechanism: SEVERITY/ADMISSION GATE. The denominator is hospital admissions only. A far larger symptomatic pool was never cultured: 250 people reported transient diarrhoea within 72h of the exposure and none were tested
temporal_alignment: Daily epidemic curve available (Fig 1, one block per person)
denominator_compatibility: Blood denominator is INFERRED (12 positive + 2 stool-only + 1 Widal-only + 11 probable with negative blood = 26), not stated verbatim. Frame is admitted patients, not community suspected cases
simple_model_status: eligible on counts (12/26) but the denominator is severity-selected
audit_notes: Blood-only 12/26 = 46.2%; the pooled 15/26 (blood+stool+Widal) must NOT be used as a blood numerator. The 250 uncultured symptomatic callers are the community pool, so the true community PPV would be far lower - this is an upper bound. 3 of 26 were admitted outside the Nice catchment, so testing practice was not uniform. Banquet cohort of 350.

specimen_scope: blood culture only
case_definition_summary: No formal definition. Cases constituted by laboratory result: '7 cases of typhoid fever infection were diagnosed (6 in Queens and 1 in Manhattan) by positive blood culture results'
testing_selection_mechanism: Not reported. Testing was incidental clinical care; NYC DOH investigated but no case-finding protocol or screening denominator is described
denominator_compatibility: pi = 1 by construction: cases ARE the blood-culture positives
source_status: primary paper READ (Zotero KJWRVYP8); Arch Intern Med 2004;164:565-567
simple_model_status: not eligible: pattern (a), cases defined by culture positivity
audit_notes: RE-READ after being wrongly skipped on the n>=20 rule. Ineligible for a better reason than size: cases are DEFINED by blood-culture positivity. Clinical-observation piece on 4 of 7 cases at one hospital, not an epidemiological report. Incidental Se_BC datum: Case 3's initial ED blood cultures were STERILE during active illness mimicking viral hepatitis; only repeat cultures 3 weeks later grew S. Typhi.

audited_suspected_testing_frame: 8 symptomatic cases (6 symptomatic culture-confirmed + 2 probable), reconstructed - the paper never reports a screened denominator
specimen_scope: confirmed definition POOLS blood and stool; positives are separable (4 blood-only, 2 stool-only, 1 both) but TESTED counts are not
case_definition_summary: Culture-confirmed = isolation of S. Typhi from stool specimens OR blood samples. Probable = acute illness with >=3 days documented fever >=38.5 C and >=3 other symptoms (headache, malaise, anorexia, nausea, abdominal discomfort, dry cough, myalgia) WITHOUT isolation of S. Typhi
testing_selection_mechanism: Active hospital/laboratory surveillance plus retrospective ED chart review plus contact tracing. Food handlers screened by stool and serology, never blood. The number blood-cultured is never reported
denominator_compatibility: Structurally eligible, empirically not: blood_tested is never reported; the confirmed definition pools blood with stool; and 'probable' is the COMPLEMENT of confirmed, not a superset, so 5/8 is a case-series composition rather than a test PPV
source_status: primary paper READ (Zotero CZSD4K5R); Clin Infect Dis 2003;37:141-144
recommended_use: exclude (eligible in structure, ineligible in data)
audit_notes: RE-READ after being wrongly skipped on n>=20. THE ONLY one of the four small papers with a genuine symptom-only probable definition. Fails on three counts: blood_tested never reported; confirmed pools blood+stool; probable defined as 'without isolation' is ambiguous between untested and test-negative (patients F and I). MSM sexual-transmission cluster from one asymptomatic carrier with gallstones.

specimen_scope: BLOOD IS NEVER MENTIONED in the paper. Only rectal swab and stool, and only for the carrier definition and employee screen
case_definition_summary: Clinically compatible illness WITH isolation of S. Typhi AND an isolate matching one of two PFGE outbreak patterns
testing_selection_mechanism: Passive notifiable-disease reporting plus a health alert. The only cohort-wide screen was 28/28 restaurant employees by self-collected RECTAL SWAB - asymptomatic staff, not symptomatic patrons
denominator_compatibility: Worse than pi=1: the PFGE requirement makes cases a SUBSET of culture-positives, so a syndromic denominator is structurally impossible
simple_model_status: not eligible: pattern (a) plus a PFGE-match requirement
audit_notes: RE-READ after being wrongly skipped on n>=20. Blood culture is never mentioned anywhere in the paper. Illustrates the general defect of the high-income foodborne stratum: carriers are screened by stool/rectal swab, patients are never screened by blood, so the cohort arm cannot yield a blood denominator.

specimen_scope: patients: blood only (clean). Employee/carrier screen: urine and stool, NOT blood
case_definition_summary: No case definition stated. Cases constituted by diagnosis plus blood culture: 'S. enterica Typhi was isolated from blood culture samples in all seven patients'; antimicrobials started 'from the day of diagnosis (with blood culture positivity)'
testing_selection_mechanism: Not reported. Patients presented independently to four hospitals and were captured by Japan's notifiable-disease surveillance. The only cohort screen was 7/7 asymptomatic employees by urine/stool
denominator_compatibility: pi = 1 by construction: 7/7 blood-positive because blood positivity defines the case
source_status: primary paper READ (Zotero I985QLEY); Am J Trop Med Hyg 2016;94:289-291
audit_notes: RE-READ after being wrongly skipped on n>=20. Covers only 7 of 14 confirmed cases in the health department's records. Index carrier (Nepali chef) found by stool, not blood. Same structural defect as Hancock-Allen: the cohort screen used urine/stool on asymptomatic staff.
